parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS alert
), coordinates AS (
  SELECT alert,
         CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(alert#>'{location,longitude}')='number'
              THEN (alert#>>'{location,longitude}')::double precision END AS longitude,
         CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(alert#>'{location,latitude}')='number'
              THEN (alert#>>'{location,latitude}')::double precision END AS latitude
  FROM input
), prepared AS (
  SELECT alert,
         CASE WHEN longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90
              THEN ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(longitude,latitude),4326) END AS supplied_alert_geom
  FROM coordinates
)
SELECT
  wi.id::text AS watch_item_uuid,
  wi.watch_id,
  wi.watch_type,
  wi.display_name,
  wi.search_term,
  wi.aliases,
  wi.match_mode,
  wi.match_field,
  wi.category,
  wi.subcategory,
  wi.parent_group,
  wi.tags,
  wi.source_filter,
  wi.alert_category_filter,
  wi.min_priority,
  wi.address,
  wi.municipality,
  wi.county,
  wi.state,
  wi.zip,
  wi.block,
  wi.lot,
  wi.qualifier,
  wi.parcel_id,
  wi.latitude,
  wi.longitude,
  wi.gis_enabled,
  wi.gis_lookup,
  wi.nearby_enabled,
  wi.radius_ft,
  sm.match_type AS spatial_match_type,
  sm.match_reason AS spatial_match_reason,
  sm.distance_ft AS spatial_distance_ft,
  sm.spatial_scope,
  COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'subscriber_uuid', s.id::text,
        'subscriber_id', s.subscriber_id,
        'name', s.name,
        'ntfy_topic', s.ntfy_topic
      )
    ) FILTER (
      WHERE wir.active = true
        AND s.active = true
        AND s.id IS NOT NULL
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS recipients
FROM prepared i
CROSS JOIN watch_items wi
LEFT JOIN LATERAL gis_active_spatial_watch_matches(i.alert->>'alert_id',i.supplied_alert_geom) sm
  ON sm.watch_item_id=wi.id
LEFT JOIN watch_item_recipients wir
  ON wir.watch_item_id = wi.id
LEFT JOIN subscribers s
  ON s.id = wir.subscriber_id
WHERE wi.active = true
  AND (wi.starts_at IS NULL OR wi.starts_at <= NOW())
  AND (wi.expires_at IS NULL OR wi.expires_at > NOW())
GROUP BY wi.id,sm.match_type,sm.match_reason,sm.distance_ft,sm.spatial_scope
ORDER BY wi.watch_id;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS p
),
resolved AS (
  SELECT
    a.id AS alert_uuid,
    (m->>'watch_item_uuid')::uuid AS watch_item_uuid,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(m->>'match_mode',''),'MATCH') AS match_type,
    NULLIF(m->>'match_reason','') AS match_reason
  FROM input i
  JOIN alerts a
    ON a.alert_id=i.p->'alert'->>'alert_id'
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    COALESCE(i.p->'matches','[]'::jsonb)
  ) m
  WHERE NULLIF(m->>'watch_item_uuid','') IS NOT NULL
),
upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO alert_watch_matches(
    alert_id,watch_item_id,match_type,match_reason,matched_at
  )
  SELECT alert_uuid,watch_item_uuid,match_type,match_reason,NOW()
  FROM resolved
  ON CONFLICT(alert_id,watch_item_id,match_type) DO UPDATE
  SET match_reason=EXCLUDED.match_reason,
      matched_at=NOW()
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT i.p AS matcher_output,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM upserted) AS persisted_match_count
FROM input i;
